name: deepseek-harness-vscode-unofficial
description: Unofficial third-party VS Code client for DeepSeek Harness: embedded Web UI in the sidebar. Not affiliated with DeepSeek AI.
author: Mu-X-Yun

dsh.deepseekApiKey.markdownDescription: DeepSeek API key. Injected into the dsh process environment (never written to `.env`). Leave empty to inherit `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` from the extension host environment.

dsh.deepseekBaseUrl.markdownDescription: Optional custom API endpoint base URL. Only honored from the process environment by dsh; the extension injects it at spawn time.

dsh.runtime.mode.markdownDescription: Where to get the dsh runtime. `auto-install` (default): install `@deepseek-ai/dsh` on first use into the extension's storage. `installed`: auto-detect a pre-installed `@deepseek-ai/dsh` (global npm install or npx cache; `dsh.runtime.path` overrides). `repo` (development): run from the `deepseek-harness-master` source checkout next to this extension.

dsh.runtime.path.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the dsh runtime. For `repo` mode: the `deepseek-harness-master` checkout (auto-detected as a sibling directory if empty). For `installed` mode: a directory containing a usable dsh install (e.g. a global node_modules).

dsh.runtime.nodePath.markdownDescription: Node executable used to spawn dsh. Default: `node` from PATH. Must be a real Node.js (>= 22) — VS Code's built-in node breaks tsx resolution when running dsh from source.

dsh.permissionMode.markdownDescription: Permission preset injected as `DSH_PERMISSION_MODE`. `workspace-write`: read/write the workspace, dangerous commands require approval. `danger-full-access`: no restriction (use at your own risk).

dsh.runtime.registry.markdownDescription: npm registry for auto-installing the dsh runtime. Leave empty for the default; a faster mirror (e.g. https://registry.npmmirror.com) can speed up first install.

dsh.runtime.port.markdownDescription: dsh web server port. 0 = random (used automatically when 3080 is occupied).

dsh.model.markdownDescription: Default model id used for new agent sessions.
